gaps: Mercy without a scene broke the initial picture of surviving debris. The forecast can act by deleting the public occasion through which its beneficiaries would have learned what happened. A missing trace can be the consequence, not a failure to find the trace.
accepted: Ghost load: beams sized for an unbuilt upper floor still determine the rooms below—their span, cost, and usable space—after the expansion plan is lost.
Reserved vacancy: a place kept empty for someone who never arrives changes who sits together and which relationships can form; the empty chair is an allocation, not an apparition.
Disinherited skill: practice for a role never taken survives as a way of handling other work; the unrealized pianist may remain in how someone times a difficult conversation.
Refusal accent: steering a sentence away from a word one decides not to say produces its peculiar rhythm and circumlocutions; the suppressed wording is absent, but the avoidance operation is audible.
Counterfactual dye: comparing an actual object with a rejected version makes one of its previously unnoticed features conspicuous; the alternative changes attention rather than the object.
Missing alarm: an event that never happens initiates a real response because a stored schedule makes its nonarrival detectable; without the expectation and a clock, there is no signal.

Mercy without a scene: a concession made to avert a predicted confrontation leaves its beneficiaries with better terms but no shared scene of winning them; the forecast acts through the conceding party.

residue.item: Borrowed witness: imagining what an absent person would later say changes the version of an episode one rehearses.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: an imagined absent witness is not necessarily an unrealized alternative. A sharper version must specify the unheld conversation rather than merely another person's imagined judgment.

residue.item: The life I almost lived: an unchosen biography haunts the biography that occurred.
residue.why: Rejected as a member: it names the atmosphere of the whole territory but supplies no mechanism distinguishing this biography's influence from longing in general.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: These are authored distinctions and conditional examples, not verified historical case studies or claims of comprehensive coverage.
Several mechanisms can coexist in one episode; overlap does not imply identity, and sequence does not assert causal necessity.
Reconstructing the cause of an absence requires evidence of the actual anticipation, intervention, or preparation; the absence alone cannot identify which alternative mattered.
Counterfactual custody cannot observe the unimplemented world's outcomes. Its promise is preserving contestable assumptions and live comparisons, not manufacturing counterfactual evidence.

gaps: Followed the missing public occasion into absent teaching lineages and absent collective witnesses, then into records that conceal successful prevention. Reversing the question produced Vacancy tenant: an absence can recruit a defender instead of preventing one. Counterfactual custody emerged as an explicitly invented response to loss of the organized alternative, not as another residual object.
accepted: Vacancy tenant: people organize a use for space reserved for a future that does not arrive, then acquire a stake in preventing that future; preparation for an alternative breeds its opponents.

Baseline laundering: successfully preventing a forecast disaster keeps its damage out of the local record; if later evaluation treats that record as untreated history, the protection appears to have had nothing to do.

Winner's negative: a surviving standard retains a prohibition introduced to distinguish it from a rejected rival, even after the rival is forgotten; exclusion preserves the lost design as an unexplained edge of the legal design space.

Extinct question: a metric built to choose between two proposed systems remains the measure of success after one is abandoned; the surviving system keeps answering a comparison that is no longer the decision anyone faces.

Permission ash: people decline apprenticeships because they expect a prohibition that is never enacted; later permission cannot instantly supply the practitioners or teaching lineages that anticipation prevented.

Unassembled witness: preempting a confrontation also prevents strangers from discovering that they have the same grievance; separate private memories survive, but the collective capable of comparing them never forms.

Counterfactual custody: speculative institution—an office for an abandoned proposal retains its assumptions and revises what would count as evidence against them, so later decisions still encounter an organized alternative without pretending it was implemented.

Fossil distinction: a vocabulary coined for a canceled project remains in everyday classification, allowing some differences to be named effortlessly while others require explanation; an unrealized undertaking bequeaths a perceptual convenience.

Orphaned affordance: earthworks prepared for a reservoir never filled leave hollows that collect seasonal water; organisms occupy a habitat produced by preparation for a different habitat, without representing that absent future.

residue.item: Silent donor: stock acquired for a canceled project becomes the material of an unrelated one.
residue.why: Plausible but not retained: this version adds a transferred stock, whereas Disinherited skill and Orphaned affordance make a more consequential contrast between migration by a prepared person and reuse by organisms that never represented the plan.

residue.item: Vanishing veto: a successful safeguard removes the threat that once made its defenders into a coalition.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: dissolution of an existing coalition could sharply contrast with Unassembled witness, but this phrasing does not yet separate lost shared purpose from the historical misreading already captured by Baseline laundering.

neighbors.left: Mercy without a scene: a concession made to avert a predicted confrontation leaves its beneficiaries with better terms but no shared scene of winning them; the forecast acts through the conceding party.
neighbors.right: Unassembled witness: preempting a confrontation also prevents strangers from discovering that they have the same grievance; separate private memories survive, but the collective capable of comparing them never forms.
neighbors.separating_case: A landlord quietly concedes after predicting a protest by an already organized tenants' union: Mercy without a scene applies, but Unassembled witness does not—the comparison-making group exists. If concession occurs before isolated tenants ever meet, both can apply. One distinguishes the missing victory episode; the other distinguishes the missing collective observer.

checks.boundary_case: An unused beam is not automatically a trace of the unlived: if no alternative specification caused its sizing, its present existence is insufficient. Likewise, an imagined alternate life belongs only when imagination, preparation, inhibition, or selection changes something actual. Alternatives not yet permanently foreclosed can qualify within a stated episode; the list does not claim knowledge of their ultimate impossibility.
checks.form_inference: The sequence changes the investigatory question from 'where is the remnant?' to 'who would have been able to see it?' The map adds a distinct feedback inference: reserving space can generate beneficiaries who prolong the reservation. Its custody edge also exposes a failure mode hidden by the ending—preserving an alternative can perpetuate an obsolete metric unless retirement is part of preservation.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read, not independent review. The haunting effect rests on ordinary carriers doing peculiar work: an audible avoidance, a useful hollow, a missing meeting, an inherited question. No absent world is assigned a literal force. The second breath changed the kind of trace sought, rather than merely adding social examples to material ones.
